title: Firewall Configuration Requirements: Private Service Edge for Internet & SaaS Deployments

blocks.text: Your organization must configure your corporate firewall to allow for remote access if:

blocks.item: The Private Service Edges for Internet & SaaS are deployed in the DMZ of your organization or behind the network firewall. To learn more, see Deploying Private Service Edge for Internet & SaaS.
Your organization uses PAC files to forward traffic from your internal network to the Private Service Edges.

blocks.text: To review your firewall configuration requirements, as well as cloud enforcement node ranges:

blocks.item: In the Cloud drop-down menu, ensure that the appropriate Zscaler cloud is selected (e.g., zscaler.net).
Review the Firewall Config Requirements and Cloud Enforcement Node Ranges sections.
